title: Humane — Free Agent Skill for Clearer Reading
description: A free Agent Skill for turning a pile of documents into one clear explanation, with a way back to the originals. MIT-licensed and experimental.
headline: Less to read.
More to understand.
intro: AI makes it easy to write more than people can read. Humane is a free Agent Skill that helps turn a pile of documents into one clear explanation you can trace back to the originals.

readingSources.title: Project plan
readingSources.body: Approve a two-week signup pilot for 20 volunteers. Proposed start: 21 September 2026, subject to venue confirmation. Estimated budget: $8,000 excluding tax, including training. A supplier quote is pending; the budget is not approved. The coordinator requests an answer by 17 September to reserve training time. Success means at least 16 of 20 complete signup without assistance, not proof of public-rollout readiness.

readingSources.title: Finance note
readingSources.body: The estimate for the same two-week, 20-volunteer pilot is $10,000 excluding tax, including training. No supplier quote or budget approval is attached. This note does not establish that it supersedes the project estimate. Both estimates exclude the venue deposit; its amount is unknown. Finance requires the final supplier quote before budget approval.

readingSources.title: Status update
readingSources.body: The venue is not confirmed. The proposed 21 September start has not been committed to volunteers. An answer is still requested by 17 September to reserve training time. The target is 20 volunteers. Twelve have expressed interest; none has formally enrolled.

writingRequest: Use Humane to turn these notes into a clear approval request.
writingTitle: Draft: please approve the pilot approach.
writingLead: We propose a two-week pilot with 20 volunteers to test a simpler workshop signup. Success means at least 16 finish without assistance.
writingCondition: The estimated cost is $8,000 excluding tax. The supplier quote is pending and the venue is unconfirmed.
writingNext: This asks for agreement on the approach, not authorization to spend before the quote arrives. A successful pilot would not establish readiness for a public rollout.
writingCoverage: Based only on the original notes.

writingSources.title: Rough notes
writingSources.body: Ask the project owner to approve testing a simpler workshop signup. Two weeks, 20 volunteers; success is at least 16 finishing without help. Estimated cost $8,000 excluding tax, supplier quote pending, venue unconfirmed. No start date or deadline agreed. Request approval of the approach, not spending before the quote. The pilot doesn't establish public-rollout readiness. No measured improvement exists yet.

faqs: Does this website read my files?
No. Use Humane in your own assistant, not on this page. That assistant handles your documents under its provider's data policies.
Will it work with my assistant?

Humane uses the open Agent Skills format. Installation was checked for Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex; skill discovery was checked in Copilot. Support varies. Not every assistant or ZIP-upload interface has been tested end to end.
Do I still need to check the response?
Yes. Check important claims against the originals. Humane gives instructions, not guarantees. It does not replace expert review where needed.
noJs: Examples and downloads work without JavaScript. Copy text manually if copy buttons are unavailable.
